title: Unveiling the active component of HuoXueTongFu formula: Emodin attenuates postoperative intra-abdominal adhesion by inhibiting HIF-1alpha-mediated glycolytic reprogramming.
authors: Chen, Yanqi; Miao, Jia; Yang, Lili; Fang, Yunda; Lian, Yuheng; Li, Guanlu; Kong, Ziyang; Zhang, Linbo; Zeng, Li; Bian, Yaoyao
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药活性成分大黄素通过结合HIF-1α抑制糖酵解重编程治疗术后腹腔粘连，虽涉及分子对接与动力学模拟，但核心对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法用于TF-DNA结合建模。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Postoperative intra-abdominal adhesion (IA), driven by hypoxia, remains a global surgical challenge due to the lack of effective therapeutic interventions. Although the herbal HuoXueTongFu Formula (HXTF) has positive effects on adhesion formation, its primary bioactive constituent and the underlying mechanism have not been fully elucidated. PURPOSE: This study aimed to identify the main bioactive constituents of HXTF, elucidate its therapeutic mechanism against IA, and provide a foundation for clinical application. METHODS: Time-course RNA sequencing with Mfuzz analysis was employed to determine the hypoxic duration-dependent transcriptional modules. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations were used to identify the major constituent of HXTF that bound to HIF-1alpha. Then, magnetic beads pull-down, co-immunoprecipitation, immunofluorescence, extracellular acidification rate (ECAR) measurements, and lactate content analysis were performed to explore the critical roles of emodin (a bioactive constituent of HXTF) on hypoxia-induced HMrSV5 (human peritoneal mesothelial) cells. With IA rodent models, adhesion scoring, H&E with Masson staining, and western blotting were applied to validate the therapeutic effect of emodin on IA. RESULTS: Mfuzz clustering analysis revealed time-dependent glycolytic reprogramming in hypoxic HMrSV5 cells, with HIF-1alpha activation peaking at 6 hours. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations identified that emodin exhibited the highest and stable binding affinity to HIF-1alpha. This effect was mediated by emodin's inhibition of HIF-1alpha nuclear translocation and disruption of its dimerization with ARNT, as evidenced by magnetic beads pull-down, co-immunoprecipitation, and immunofluorescence assays. ECAR measurements and lactate content analysis in vitro showed that emodin effectively downregulated HIF-1alpha-mediated transcriptional activation of glycolysis gene expression (e.g., GLUT3 and PFKFB3) and decreased lactate content. Moreover, emodin alleviated the intra-abdominal adhesion formation in vivo by reducing the fibrous band formation and collagen deposition, which was achieved by suppression of the HIF-1alpha-mediated glycolytic reprogramming. CONCLUSION: Emodin could reduce IA formation by inhibiting HIF-1alpha-mediated glycolytic reprogramming. This effect was achieved through direct binding with HIF-1alpha, which subsequently inhibited its nuclear translocation and disrupted its dimerization with ARNT, thereby downregulating HIF-1alpha-mediated transcriptional activation of glycolytic gene expression (e.g., GLUT3 and PFKFB3) and reducing lactate content. These findings suggest that emodin may be a promising therapeutic candidate to attenuate IA.
abstract_zh: 背景：术后腹腔内粘连（IA）由缺氧驱动，由于缺乏有效治疗干预措施，仍是全球性外科挑战。尽管中药活血通腑方（HXTF）对粘连形成具有积极作用，但其主要生物活性成分及潜在机制尚未完全阐明。目的：本研究旨在鉴定HXTF的主要生物活性成分，阐明其抗IA的治疗机制，并为临床应用提供基础。方法：采用时间序列RNA测序结合Mfuzz分析，确定缺氧持续时间依赖性转录模块。利用分子对接和动力学模拟，鉴定HXTF中与HIF-1α结合的主要成分。随后，通过磁珠pull-down、免疫共沉淀、免疫荧光、细胞外酸化率（ECAR）测量和乳酸含量分析，探讨大黄素（HXTF的一种生物活性成分）在缺氧诱导的HMrSV5（人腹膜间皮）细胞中的关键作用。在IA啮齿动物模型中，采用粘连评分、H&E联合Masson染色和western blotting，验证大黄素对IA的治疗效果。结果：Mfuzz聚类分析揭示，缺氧HMrSV5细胞中发生时间依赖性糖酵解重编程，HIF-1α激活在6小时达到峰值。分子对接和动力学模拟鉴定出大黄素对HIF-1α具有最高且稳定的结合亲和力。该效应通过大黄素抑制HIF-1α核转位并破坏其与ARNT的二聚化介导，磁珠pull-down、免疫共沉淀和免疫荧光实验证实了这一点。体外ECAR测量和乳酸含量分析显示，大黄素有效下调HIF-1α介导的糖酵解基因表达（如GLUT3和PFKFB3）的转录激活，并降低乳酸含量。此外，大黄素通过抑制HIF-1α介导的糖酵解重编程，减少纤维条带形成和胶原沉积，从而在体内减轻腹腔内粘连形成。结论：大黄素通过抑制HIF-1α介导的糖酵解重编程减少IA形成。该效应通过与HIF-1α直接结合实现，随后抑制其核转位并破坏其与ARNT的二聚化，从而下调HIF-1α介导的糖酵解基因表达（如GLUT3和PFKFB3）的转录激活并降低乳酸含量。这些发现表明，大黄素可能是减轻IA的有前景的治疗候选药物。
